apps.localizedDescription:
## What's New

**Block Tracking.** A new switch under Ad Blocking, on by default, stops Twitch's usage tracking, crash reports and ad measurement from being sent. Nothing in the app changes; it just sends less about you.

**Full quality on Automatic.** One of the built-in servers is in a country where Twitch limits streams to 720p. Automatic now only uses it as a backup when the others are down, so you get 1080p (and higher) without changing anything. It's marked "backup, up to 720p" in the server list, and you can still pick it yourself.

**Servers update without an app update.** The server list now updates by itself in the background. If a server goes down, slows down or starts showing ads, it can be swapped out or a new one added within minutes, and you get it the next time you open the app, with nothing to install. If the list can't be downloaded, the app keeps using the one it already has.

**Fixed "Try Ad-Free" on your profile.** Twitch 32.2 rebuilt the profile page, so Hide "Go Ad-Free" Button no longer removed its "Try Ad-Free" button, and the old way of hiding it could upset the layout of the page. It's now removed cleanly, with no leftover gap.

**Fixed missing category buttons on the Live page.** With Hide "From Channels You Follow" on, the buttons above the streams (All, League of Legends and so on) didn't show until you scrolled or switched tabs. They now show as soon as the page opens.

## Downloads

|------|-------------|
| `tv.twitch-32.2-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.26.ipa` | Sideload IPA (AltStore / SideStore / Feather) |
| `tv.twitch-32.2-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.26-no-plugins.ipa` | Sideload IPA without app extensions (TrollStore) |
| `com.level3tjg.twitchadblock_0.1.26_iphoneos-arm.deb` | Rootful deb (unc0ver / checkra1n) |
| `com.level3tjg.twitchadblock_0.1.26_iphoneos-arm64.deb` | Rootless deb (Dopamine / palera1n) |
